summary: to_string_pretty previously behaved identically to to_string, leaving nested tables inline and omitting multiline array formatting. The fix applies a Pretty visitor that expands tables and arrays of tables and formats multi-element arrays with indentation and trailing commas. Reversing only this function restores the original behavior. The fix-added pretty_std test in tests/pretty.rs compares serialization against the expected pretty output and requires the easy feature. This is a source-based plan; no builds or tests were run.
